title: Casino Lisboa (Macau)
visualBrief: Complete original Hotel/Casino Lisboa from native circular front tower/T-shaped rear tower/bent eastern wing, plus bounded inferred low connectors/west domed annex, aqua scalloped entrance canopy and signboard. Ochre walls, dark recessed glazing, strong white vertical/curving and octagonal relief window tracery, stepped wing heights, three flared white ribbed roof/open-fin crowns with genuinely pierced gold radial finials, intrinsic entry platforms/stairs and original geometric name lettering. Native site boundary is not a building slab. Separate GrandLisboa/BankofChina/Wynn/roundabout/transit pavilion and landscape excluded; hidden layout/sections/height conventions/contact are estimates.
